Notes on the greenhouse helpers, in our own words.

The yield helper divides the count of seeds that came up by the count planted and turns the
ratio into a percentage with two decimals; a tray with nothing planted scores zero.

The reshelving routine walks every tray on one bench and, for each tray marked as wilted, moves
it to the quarantine shelf in the north glasshouse and logs a short line for the misting crew.

The misting helper maps relative humidity to a number of minutes: drier air gets longer misting
(twelve minutes under thirty-five percent, seven under fifty-five, three under seventy-five) and
humid air gets none.
